gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-sintony: Wallpoet is bold and commanding, with lowercase that climbs high and a bit of paper showing between its letters. But Sintony, chunky through the middle with curves that never clog, keeps the read smooth and contemporary.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-sono: Warnes is expressive and bold, its ink strokes tapering out before they touch. Sono comes with wide default spacing and a lowercase a whose mouth stays ajar, approachable without any extra tracking.
gen-irish-grover-gf-stack-sans-headline: Fun and organic, Irish Grover makes its words look sturdy and large. Stack Sans Headline keeps a monoline skeleton and wide gaps that hold up at tiny sizes, set against Irish Grover's softly varied strokes.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-pt-sans-caption: Widely set letters with generous clearance give Goldman its commanding stance. PT Sans Caption has big-bodied lowercase and bowls that feel unclosed, so paragraphs of it stay inviting line after line.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-questrial: Loud and lively: Grandstander draws constant-width lines with letters held open instead of curled shut, and its ascenders stay short. Questrial's flat, stencil-cut strokes sit quietly beneath it.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-bespoke-sans: Bookish and nostalgic: Mystery Quest opens a jaw on every curved stroke and tucks compact ascenders over high lowercase. One sets the mood, while Bespoke Sans supplies the sharp, refined detail.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-abeezee: Mystery Quest wears a bookish, nostalgic look, with open jaws on every curved stroke and compact ascenders above its high lowercase. ABeeZee stays friendly beneath it, its neon-tube strokes finishing well clear of the stem.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-alexandria: Open jaws on every curved stroke give Mystery Quest a bookish, nostalgic face, with compact ascenders over high lowercase. Alexandria keeps things clean and polished, its c terminals flung wide.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-amiko: Amiko draws modern lowercase with the heft of a crayon mark, its terminals pointing outward like a pair of tongs. Mystery Quest, bookish and nostalgic, supplies the old-fashioned lean above.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari has distinctly open letter mouths and a deep middle zone of letters. Anek Devanagari feels modern beside Mystery Quest's bookish, nostalgic voice, plain-spoken where the heading is storied.
